Welcome to The Grove at Germantown Apartments â€“ Your Perfect Home AwaitsOur apartments in Germantown, TN offer a seamless blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Choose from spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments ranging from 790 to 1,393 square feet, or explore our expansive townhomes up to 1,610 square feet. Nestled in a prestigious location near renowned museums and backing onto Shelby Farms, The Grove at Germantown combines the beauty of nature with urban accessibility. Our community is located just 15 miles from Downtown Memphis, 16 miles from Memphis International Airport, and only 8 minutes from Malco Cordova Cinema, placing entertainment, travel, and city attractions within easy reach. Our community is packed with exceptional amenities, including an award-winning FIT Studio, two sparkling swimming pools, a virtual yoga studio, and lighted tennis and pickleball courts. Relax by one of seven scenic lakes, entertain at the outdoor kitchen overlooking the water, or explore the nearby Greenway trails. Additional conveniences include a pet spa, car care center, conference and lounge areas, and a stand-alone clubhouse available for private events. We are also a pet-friendly community with no breed restrictions and a limit of two pets per home. Adding to the appeal, The Grove is situated within the highly regarded Germantown Municipal School District (GMSD), consistently ranked among the top in Tennessee for academic excellence and student achievement. With newly renovated homes and exciting new amenitiesâ€”coming soonâ€”you'll find a living experience that redefines comfort and modern living. Schedule your tour today and discover why The Grove at Germantown is the perfect place to call home.

About The Grove Germantown Apartments

Welcome to The Grove at Germantown Apartments â€“ Your Perfect Home AwaitsOur apartments in Germantown, TN offer a seamless blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Choose from spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments ranging from 790 to 1,393 square feet, or explore our expansive townhomes up to 1,610 square feet.

Nestled in a prestigious location near renowned museums and backing onto Shelby Farms, The Grove at Germantown combines the beauty of nature with urban accessibility. Our community is located just 15 miles from Downtown Memphis, 16 miles from Memphis International Airport, and only 8 minutes from Malco Cordova Cinema, placing entertainment, travel, and city attractions within easy reach.

Our community is packed with exceptional amenities, including an award-winning FIT Studio, two sparkling swimming pools, a virtual yoga studio, and lighted tennis and pickleball courts. Relax by one of seven scenic lakes, entertain at the outdoor kitchen overlooking the water, or explore the nearby Greenway trails. Additional conveniences include a pet spa, car care center, conference and lounge areas, and a stand-alone clubhouse available for private events. We are also a pet-friendly community with no breed restrictions and a limit of two pets per home.

Adding to the appeal, The Grove is situated within the highly regarded Germantown Municipal School District (GMSD), consistently ranked among the top in Tennessee for academic excellence and student achievement.

With newly renovated homes and exciting new amenitiesâ€”coming soonâ€”you'll find a living experience that redefines comfort and modern living. Schedule your tour today and discover why The Grove at Germantown is the perfect place to call home.

The Grove Germantown Apartments is an apartment community located in Shelby County and the 38138 ZIP Code. This area is served by the Germantown Municipal School District attendance zone.

City - Germantown

Germantown is a historic suburban community about a half-hour drive from downtown Memphis. Originally settled in 1825, the city flourished as a railroad town and now features a variety of modern conveniences.

Old Germantown has a lot of history. Anchored by railroad tracks and the Germantown Train Depot Museum, residents can learn about the locomotives used in the area during its early outpost days. Surrounding Old Germantown, youâ€™ll discover salons, art studios, and delicious eateries near luxury apartments.

With more than twenty-five parks, residents of Germantown enjoy a vast public parks system. Municipal Park is home to Shelby Countyâ€™s oldest brick home, the John Gray House. Residents and visitors alike enjoy the relics at Fort Germantown off Honey Tree Drive. Community events include horse shows and Germantown Festival. Travel is made simple by way of Interstate 240 and Memphis International Airport.

Frequently Asked Questions
Does this property have in-unit laundry?

This property has units with inâ€‘unit washers and dryers, making laundry day simple for residents.

What utilities are included in rent at this property?

Utilities are not included in rent. Residents should plan to set up and pay for all services separately.

Is parking available at this property?

Parking is available at this property. Fees may apply depending on the type of parking offered. Contact this property for details.

Which floor plans are available, and what are the price ranges?

This property has one to three-bedrooms with rent ranges from $1,315/mo. to $2,711/mo.

Is this property pet-friendly?

Yes, this property welcomes pets. Breed restrictions, weight limits, and additional fees may apply. View this property's pet policy.

How much income do I need to rent at this property?

A good rule of thumb is to spend no more than 30% of your gross income on rent. Based on the lowest available rent of $1,315 for a one-bedroom, you would need to earn about $52,600 per year to qualify. Want to double-check your budget? Calculate how much rent you can afford with our Rent Affordability Calculator.

Does this property have move-in specials?

This property is not currently offering any rent specials. Check back soon, as promotions change frequently.

Does this property offer Matterport 3D tours?

Yes! This property offers 11 Matterport 3D Tours. Explore different floor plans and see unit level details, all without leaving home.
